summary:
Round 1: CHANGES_REQUESTED at PR head 2535f0a919a447f4469b9d88f56f0008336c930a (code head c336112cf94f52e73b948c4cbab3903cce260a7c), review https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/1121#pullrequestreview-5207053333. The production change is exactly the controller's ruling: two hunks in workspace.ts, both inside createProvisioningCredential (doc comment + the five GIT_CONFIG_* pairs); the persisted config writes, credentialConfigCommands and processes.ts are untouched; only the clone and the fetch receive credential.env; the old GIT_CONFIG_COUNT-undefined pin is gone; no API/contract/state change. One blocking test-correctness finding: the new regression test's persisted-config reads (workspace.test.ts:780-786, 811-812) run `git config --get-all` with no env, so they inherit the box's global/system git config and fail on any developer box with a global credential.helper (reproduced: `store

!<pane>
` vs the asserted `
!<pane>
`); one-line fix (`{ env: isolation }` or `--local`). Everything else is wording/duplication batched into one fast-follow.

keyFindings.description:
persisted() runs `git config --get-all` via runCommand with no env, inheriting the box's global and system scopes; with a global credential.helper the three --get-all assertions (782, 783, 811) fail before the contract is exercised. Reproduced on git 2.43 with a global `credential.helper = store` → `store

!/x/pane
`. Fix: pass `{ env: isolation }` to that runCommand, or add `--local` — both verified.

Fast-follow: collapse provisioningEnv (toMatchObject + GIT_ASKPASS regex + Object.keys set vs PROVISIONING_ENV_NAMES) and the workspace-init.test.ts block into one toEqual with an asymmetric matcher on GIT_ASKPASS each (immune to the Bun 1.3.14 toMatchObject quirk, verified; same shape processes.test.ts already uses); build the negative control positively.

Fast-follow: the module-level `await runCommand([SYSTEM_GIT, "--version"])` (143-150) turns a missing /usr/bin/git into a whole-file load failure; move it into the one test that uses it. The `PR #753's b0c456b5` citation (line 50) names a pre-squash sha that resolves to nothing here; cite the squash 9278a29c.

Fast-follow: processEnvRunner's doc comment (27-29) still enumerates only GIT_ASKPASS, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT, LEGION_PROVISIONING_TOKEN; name the GIT_CONFIG_* pairs or point at createProvisioningCredential.

verified.github: Tests (lint, typecheck, test), PR Title and Worker Image/build pass at 2535f0a9 (Worker Image run 34940249250; run 34938845664 at c336112c published sha256:ba1b0242…6060d, the kind proofs' digest). Zero threads before this review. E2E (implementer) and E2E (tester) both present with surface, command/run id, observation, head c336112c and a negative control. mergeable MERGEABLE / mergeStateStatus BLOCKED — no rebase.
verified.gitSemantics: Real git 2.43: a bare clone with the pane helper only under credential.https://github.com.helper + credential.interactive=false yields the askpass credential with no helper run under the five pairs. Source (git v2.47.3): credential.c sets urlmatch select_fn = select_all (every matching entry applied in read order) and an empty helper value clears the list; GIT_CONFIG_* is command scope read after the repository file. The doc comment is accurate in effect and cause.
verified.bunQuirk: Reproduced on Bun 1.3.14: toMatchObject with expect.stringContaining fails on the second match of the same received object; plain values twice pass; toEqual with the matcher has no quirk. The workspace-init.test.ts comment is accurate.
verified.thermo: thermonuclear-deep-review + thermonuclear-code-quality once at c336112c. Deep: env contract correct end to end (jj 0.45.1 probe with an interposed git saw all eight names untouched; withoutSecretLikeNames applies to paneEnv only); security unchanged; one Major (the blocking item). Quality: exactly the ruled contract, test defends the observable contract, exact-key-set assertion is a real contract (an extra GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2 without bumping COUNT is silently ignored by git); simplifications only.
